what: Exploratory QA of the deployed Signalpost web app by Momentic's QA agent (Mo), from a written brief, with no access to the code. Summary of its report; screenshots are kept by the project owner.
limits_followed: No sign-in, no external forms submitted, under 30 company look-ups, exactly one registry re-check per company.

companies_checked_in_depth.name: EQUINOR ASA
companies_checked_in_depth.result: Six source kinds checked; registry, roles, accounts, sub-units and contacts agree; all ten news dates match the feed; website and social links trace to the company's site.

companies_checked_in_depth.name: FLEXIFORM AS
companies_checked_in_depth.result: Registry, roles, sub-unit, accounts 2023 to 2025 and contacts agree; all 75 detailed facts have source links; website and Facebook/LinkedIn identity agree.

companies_checked_in_depth.name: HOMELY AS
companies_checked_in_depth.result: All 90 detailed facts linked; the three published vacancies are single live Homely ads; three more live ads on its Jobylon list were left out (issue 6).

issues.found: Hiring tile showed the internal code "checked nav no active ads last 60 days".
issues.fix: Every availability reason is shown in plain words.

issues.found: Same internal code on the Hiring tile.
Twelve historical registry events moved one day later and were reported as changes (for example the employee count update of 2026-10-13, feed time 22:04 UTC, shown as 2026-10-14).
issues.fix: Event dates are the UTC day of the feed's timestamp however it is written (Z, an offset, or Norwegian local time); an event with the same update id and content is never reported as changed for a one-day difference.
tests: registry timestamps: the same instant gets the same UTC day
QA run (Equinor): the same registry update written with a Norwegian time offset keeps its day and is not reported as a change

issues.found: The Changes sentence printed raw JSON objects.
issues.fix: Every change is written in words.
tests: QA run (Equinor): the summary's change list is written in words, never raw JSON

issues.found: Revenue and growth were followed only by an Enhetsregisteret link.
issues.fix: The envelope already cited the accounts; the app showed only the first three evidence items, all from Enhetsregisteret. It now shows every distinct source behind a sentence.

issues.found: 3 of the 6 ads on Homely's live Jobylon list were left out (posted 2024-02-28, 2026-03-17 and 2026-04-28, no end date, still open).
issues.fix: An ad that the employer's own live job list still carries is an opening whatever its age; its own page must still be live and name the company.
tests: jobs (QA run, homely.no): an old ad on the employer's live Jobylon list is an opening; one whose page says it is closed is not

issues.where: How it works, Sources and licence
issues.found: The Regnskapsregisteret link (the API root) returned 404.
issues.fix: Links the official dataset page on data.norge.no.

issues.found: The run command needed sideways scrolling.
The sources table needed sideways scrolling.
issues.fix: On a phone each source is one block with its result, time and hash.

issues.found: The second company was off screen.
issues.fix: On a phone each fact lists every company under it.

also_noted.found: A filter that matches nothing showed only the table headers (not confirmed as a defect).
also_noted.fix: Says "No companies match this filter" with a button to clear the filters.

also_noted.found: The How it works page still described version 4 (no news or careers pages).

not_verified_by_the_qa_agent: That NAV has no active ads for the three companies (the NAV feed needs a token in a browser).
Content of social accounts behind a login (Instagram, Facebook, X security check); ownership was confirmed from the companies' own sites.
An untouched batch table of exactly 10 companies (live look-ups are added to it, as the page says).
The missing-employee-count and no-dated-items branches (no such company within the allowed look-ups).

re_run.result: 9 of the 10 issues verified fixed on the live demo; no new issues.

not_reachable_live.why: The change list appears only when a source has changed; all three re-checks found no changes, so the agent could not see it. The offline self-test covers it: "QA run (Equinor): the summary's change list is written in words, never raw JSON".

details.equinor: 16 registry event dates unchanged after a re-check; 181 facts re-confirmed, no changes, no duplicates.
details.flexiform: At a glance cites Regnskapsregisteret, whose accounts contain the 2025 revenue NOK 40,507,033.
details.homely: 6 open positions, the 6 ads on its live Jobylon list, each opened and showing an application option and no closing notice.
details.phone: At 375 px the run command, the sources list and Compare (two and three companies) need no sideways scrolling.

still_not_verifiable_by_the_qa_agent: NAV absence (the feed needs a token in a browser).
Social account content behind a login.
Missing-value and empty-news branches (no such company within the allowed look-ups).
